messages:
maria: Hey — docs PR #452 is blocked on a runtime clarification. The streaming SDK snippet currently shows a naive auto-retry on connection reset (example uses `client.stream({retry: true})`). CI docs preview fails because the example asserts a single FINAL event order. Need to confirm: does the platform/SDK auto-retry interrupted streaming requests, and how does canary model fallback interact with in-flight streams? @sam @jamie

sam: Quick clarification: SDK does NOT transparently auto-retry an interrupted streaming connection for generation calls. On disconnect we emit an error to the app; the app must re-open the stream if it wants retries. We do have automatic fallback behavior for non-streaming (sync) requests only — not for active websocket/stream sessions.

alex: OK — so docs should show a reconnect pattern rather than implying auto-retry. Do we have a recommended snippet for handling partial output + restart (dedupe last tokens)?

jamie: From infra/runtime side: in-flight streams can't be re-routed to a different model without restarting the request. Canary routing decisions are made at request start. If a stream disconnects and the client retries, the retry will follow normal routing rules (canary vs stable) at that new request time. Note: retrying can produce duplicate tokens if the client resumes without truncation.

sam: For the snippet, recommend: capture last acked token index, on reconnect request the remaining tokens with a conversation state or `prefix` so the model continues without repeating. We don't expose a server-side resume token for streams today.

alex: Got it. I'll update the PR examples to: 1) remove `retry: true` from the streaming convenience API, 2) add a short reconnect + dedupe pattern using conversation state, and 3) add a callout: "canary routing applies per new request; in-flight streams won't auto-fallback."

maria: CI notes: the docs preview broke because the code block used `assert final_event == true` — I'll change tests to allow multiple partial events and an explicit error event for disconnects.

deploy-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #452 — link: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-452/checks (flaky snippet test) :warning:

maria: Thanks everyone — this is enough to unblock. I'll push the snippet update and ping again if anything else comes up. Marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
